thread:
Alice Nguyen: FYI — Greenfield support ticket: their tool invoke is returning JSON schema validation errors (422) and the client keeps retrying. Billing spiked for the last hour. Sharing logs and repro below.

support-bot: ALERT: svc-invoke validation.failed (422) trace=tx_0af3c2fde1 

Alice Nguyen: Error payload we got from gateway:
```
{"status":422,"error":"ValidationError","message":"data/tool_args: additionalProperties 'debug_mode' not allowed; data/billing_profile: required property missing; data/session: expected object but got null"}
```

Mateo Cruz: Can you paste the original request body (redact secrets) and which endpoint/version? Also is this hosted or Dedicated for Greenfield?

Alice Nguyen: They called POST /v1/tools/invoke on Dedicated (v1.12.3). Repro curl (redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://dedicated-eu.redwood/api/v1/tools/invoke \  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \  -d '{"tool_name":"billing-attach","tool_args":{"user_id":"u123","plan":"pro","debug_mode":true,"session":null},"metadata":{"source":"ui"}}'
```

Ingrid Patel: Looks like two distinct problems: 1) the schema requires `billing_profile` (object) but client is sending `plan` as a string; 2) validator forbids `debug_mode` as additionalProperties on tool_args. `session` being null fails type check (expected object).

Samir (SRE): Gateway log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-17T09:02:11Z] tx=tx_0af3c2fde1 svc-invoke validator: reject path=/tool_args code=additionalProperties key=debug_mode; path=/billing_profile code=required missing=billing_profile; path=/session code=type expected=object got=null
```
This matches the 422 back to the customer. Their client SDK swallows 422 and retries, producing extra charges.

Mateo Cruz: Did we tighten the toolcall schema in the Feb 20 deploy? Could be a breaking strictness bump. If it's a Dedicated customer on an older runtime, maybe mismatch between client expectations and server validator.

Alice Nguyen: Greenfield is on Dedicated but using our managed control plane (customer lock). They updated client yesterday via internal rollout. Billing volume up ~30% due to retries. Customer asks for immediate mitigation.

Ingrid Patel: Short-term mitigation options: 
- Allow additionalProperties on `tool_args` at validation layer and persist them to audit.
- Treat `session: null` as omitted (coerce null->undefined) for compatibility.
Long-term: update SDK to run client-side validation and give clear 400 before sending.

Samir (SRE): I can prepare a hotfix to relax additionalProperties for `tool_args` and add null coercion for `session`. Patch would be tiny in validator shim (two lines). If approved, we can roll to Dedicated fleet and push a changelist to hosted tonight. Also I'll temporarily disable aggressive client retries for Greenfield at the gateway to stop billing churn.

Mateo Cruz: +1 to the hotfix. Need change approved by product/infra. I'll open a fast-track changelist and include test cases. Also will add a short-lived feature flag so we can roll back quickly. ETA 3 hours.

Alice Nguyen: Action items: 
- @Samir (SRE) patch validator and deploy hotfix to Dedicated (urgent).
- @Mateo Cruz open fast-track CL and coordinate rollback plan.
- @Ingrid Patel draft customer message explaining root cause and the mitigation timeline.
I'll notify Greenfield that we're working this and will pause retries on their gateway.

Samir (SRE): On it. I'll also add request-tracing header to responses so Greenfield can correlate retries and we'll capture token-cost delta for billing team.

support-bot: Escalation created INC-2026-1043 assigned to infra-oncall.

Mateo Cruz: acked. Will post status here when CL is green. :thumbsup:

Alice Nguyen: Thanks team — please add notes to the support ticket and cc billing for refund assessment if needed.
